verses.original: מִקֵּ֥ץ שֶֽׁבַע־ שָׁנִ֖ים תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה שְׁמִטָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: miq·qêṣ še·ḇa‘- šā·nîm ta·‘ă·śeh šə·miṭ·ṭāh
verses.literal: At the end of every seven years you must cancel debts
verses.literalPt: No fim de cada sete anos, farás a remissão.

verses.original: וְזֶה֮ דְּבַ֣ר הַשְּׁמִטָּה֒ שָׁמ֗וֹט כָּל־ בַּ֙עַל֙ מַשֵּׁ֣ה יָד֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יַשֶּׁ֖ה בְּרֵעֵ֑הוּ לֹֽא־ יִגֹּ֤שׂ אֶת־ רֵעֵ֙הוּ֙ וְאֶת־ אָחִ֔יו כִּֽי־ קָרָ֥א שְׁמִטָּ֖ה לַֽיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·zeh də·ḇar haš·šə·miṭ·ṭāh šā·mō·wṭ kāl- ba·‘al maš·šêh yā·ḏōw ’ă·šer yaš·šeh bə·rê·‘ê·hū lō- yig·gōś ’eṯ- rê·‘ê·hū wə·’eṯ- ’ā·ḥîw kî- qā·rā šə·miṭ·ṭāh Yah·weh
verses.literal: This is the manner of remission Every creditor . . . . . . shall cancel what he has loaned to his neighbor He is not to collect anything from his neighbor or brother because the LORD’s time of release has been proclaimed
verses.literalPt: Este é o modo da remissão: todo credor remitirá o que tem emprestado ao seu próximo; não o exigirá do seu próximo e do seu patrício, por se ter proclamada a remissão de Jeová.

verses.original: אֶת־ הַנָּכְרִ֖י תִּגֹּ֑שׂ וַאֲשֶׁ֨ר יִהְיֶ֥ה לְךָ֛ אֶת־ אָחִ֖יךָ תַּשְׁמֵ֥ט יָדֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ- han·nā·ḵə·rî tig·gōś wa·’ă·šer yih·yeh lə·ḵā ’eṯ- ’ā·ḥî·ḵā taš·mêṭ yā·ḏe·ḵā
verses.literal: You may collect something from a foreigner but you must forgive . . . whatever your brother owes you . . .
verses.literalPt: Do estrangeiro poderás exigi-lo; porém tudo o que é teu que estiver no poder do teu patrício, remita-o a tua mão.

verses.original: אֶ֕פֶס כִּ֛י לֹ֥א יִֽהְיֶה־ בְּךָ֖ אֶבְי֑וֹן כִּֽי־ בָרֵ֤ךְ יְבָֽרֶכְךָ֙ יְהוָ֔ה בָּאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ נֹֽתֵן־ לְךָ֥ נַחֲלָ֖ה לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’e·p̄es kî lō yih·yeh- bə·ḵā ’eḇ·yō·wn kî- ḇā·rêḵ yə·ḇā·reḵ·ḵā Yah·weh bā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā nō·ṯên- lə·ḵā na·ḥă·lāh lə·riš·tāh
verses.literal: There will be no poor among you however . . . because the LORD will surely bless you . . . in the land that the LORD your God is giving you to possess as an inheritance
verses.literalPt: Contudo, não haverá entre ti pobre algum (pois Jeová, certamente, te abençoará na terra que Jeová, teu Deus, te está dando por herança, para a possuíres),

verses.original: רַ֚ק אִם־ שָׁמ֣וֹעַ תִּשְׁמַ֔ע בְּק֖וֹל יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ לִשְׁמֹ֤ר לַעֲשׂוֹת֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ הַמִּצְוָ֣ה הַזֹּ֔את אֲשֶׁ֛ר אָנֹכִ֥י מְצַוְּךָ֖ הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: raq ’im- šā·mō·w·a‘ tiš·ma‘ bə·qō·wl Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā liš·mōr la·‘ă·śō·wṯ ’eṯ- kāl- ham·miṣ·wāh haz·zōṯ ’ă·šer ’ā·nō·ḵî mə·ṣaw·wə·ḵā hay·yō·wm
verses.literal: if only you obey . . . . . . the LORD your God and are careful to follow all these commandments I am giving you today . . .
verses.literalPt: se somente ouvires diligentemente a voz de Jeová, teu Deus, para cuidares de cumprir todo este mandamento que eu hoje te ordeno.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ בֵּֽרַכְךָ֔ כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּר־ לָ֑ךְ וְהַֽעֲבַטְתָּ֞ גּוֹיִ֣ם רַבִּ֗ים וְאַתָּה֙ לֹ֣א תַעֲבֹ֔ט וּמָֽשַׁלְתָּ֙ בְּגוֹיִ֣ם רַבִּ֔ים וּבְךָ֖ לֹ֥א יִמְשֹֽׁלוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā bê·raḵ·ḵā ka·’ă·šer dib·ber- lāḵ wə·ha·‘ă·ḇaṭ·tā gō·w·yim rab·bîm wə·’at·tāh lō ṯa·‘ă·ḇōṭ ū·mā·šal·tā bə·ḡō·w·yim rab·bîm ū·ḇə·ḵā lō yim·šō·lū
verses.literal: When the LORD your God blesses you as He has promised you will lend to many . . . nations but borrow from none you will rule over many nations but be ruled by none
verses.literalPt: Porque Jeová, teu Deus, te abençoará, como te prometeu; emprestarás a muitas nações, mas não tomarás empréstimos; dominarás sobre muitas nações, porém elas não dominarão sobre ti.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ יִהְיֶה֩ בְךָ֨ אֶבְי֜וֹן מֵאַחַ֤ד אַחֶ֙יךָ֙ בְּאַחַ֣ד שְׁעָרֶ֔יךָ בְּאַ֨רְצְךָ֔ אֲשֶׁר־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ נֹתֵ֣ן לָ֑ךְ לֹ֧א תְאַמֵּ֣ץ אֶת־ לְבָבְךָ֗ וְלֹ֤א תִקְפֹּץ֙ אֶת־ יָ֣דְךָ֔ מֵאָחִ֖יךָ הָאֶבְיֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: kî- yih·yeh ḇə·ḵā ’eḇ·yō·wn mê·’a·ḥaḏ ’a·ḥe·ḵā bə·’a·ḥaḏ šə·‘ā·re·ḵā bə·’ar·ṣə·ḵā ’ă·šer- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā nō·ṯên lāḵ lō ṯə·’am·mêṣ ’eṯ- lə·ḇā·ḇə·ḵā wə·lō ṯiq·pōṣ ’eṯ- yā·ḏə·ḵā mê·’ā·ḥî·ḵā hā·’eḇ·yō·wn
verses.literal: If there is a poor man among your brothers within any of the gates in the land that the LORD your God is giving you then you are not to harden your heart or shut your hand from your poor brother
verses.literalPt: Se, no meio de ti, houver um pobre, qualquer de teus irmãos, numa das tuas cidades na tua terra que Jeová, teu Deus, te está dando, não endurecerás o teu coração, nem fecharás a mão ao teu irmão pobre;

verses.original: כִּֽי־ פָתֹ֧חַ תִּפְתַּ֛ח אֶת־ יָדְךָ֖ ל֑וֹ וְהַעֲבֵט֙ תַּעֲבִיטֶ֔נּוּ דֵּ֚י מַחְסֹר֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֶחְסַ֖ר לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- p̄ā·ṯō·aḥ tip̄·taḥ ’eṯ- yā·ḏə·ḵā lōw wə·ha·‘ă·ḇêṭ ta·‘ă·ḇî·ṭen·nū dê maḥ·sō·rōw ’ă·šer yeḥ·sar lōw
verses.literal: Instead you are to open . . . your hand to him and freely loan him whatever he needs -
verses.literalPt: mas, certamente, lhe abrirás a tua mão e, sem dúvida, lhe emprestarás quanto baste para a sua necessidade naquilo que lhe falta.

verses.original: הִשָּׁ֣מֶר לְךָ֡ פֶּן־ יִהְיֶ֣ה דָבָר֩ עִם־ לְבָבְךָ֨ בְלִיַּ֜עַל לֵאמֹ֗ר קָֽרְבָ֣ה שְׁנַֽת־ הַשֶּׁבַע֮ שְׁנַ֣ת הַשְּׁמִטָּה֒ וְרָעָ֣ה עֵֽינְךָ֗ בְּאָחִ֙יךָ֙ הָֽאֶבְי֔וֹן וְלֹ֥א תִתֵּ֖ן ל֑וֹ וְקָרָ֤א עָלֶ֙יךָ֙ אֶל־ יְהוָ֔ה וְהָיָ֥ה בְךָ֖ חֵֽטְא׃
verses.transliteration: hiš·šā·mer lə·ḵā pen- yih·yeh ḏā·ḇār ‘im- lə·ḇā·ḇə·ḵā ḇə·lî·ya·‘al lê·mōr qā·rə·ḇāh šə·naṯ- haš·še·ḇa‘ šə·naṯ haš·šə·miṭ·ṭāh wə·rā·‘āh ‘ê·nə·ḵā bə·’ā·ḥî·ḵā hā·’eḇ·yō·wn wə·lō ṯit·tên lōw wə·qā·rā ‘ā·le·ḵā ’el- Yah·weh wə·hā·yāh ḇə·ḵā ḥêṭ
verses.literal: Be careful not to harbor . . . this wicked . . . thought in your heart The seventh year the year of release is near so that you look upon your poor brother begrudgingly and give him nothing He will cry out to the LORD against you and you will be guilty of sin
verses.literalPt: Guarda-te que não haja um pensamento depravado no teu coração, nem digas: Está próximo o sétimo ano, o ano da remissão; de modo que o teu olho seja mau para com o teu irmão pobre, e não lhe dês nada, e ele clame contra ti a Jeová, e isso seja pecado da tua parte.

verses.original: נָת֤וֹן תִּתֵּן֙ ל֔וֹ וְלֹא־ יֵרַ֥ע לְבָבְךָ֖ בְּתִתְּךָ֣ ל֑וֹ כִּ֞י בִּגְלַ֣ל׀ הַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֗ה יְבָרֶכְךָ֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ בְּכָֽל־ מַעֲשֶׂ֔ךָ וּבְכֹ֖ל מִשְׁלַ֥ח יָדֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: nā·ṯō·wn tit·tên lōw wə·lō- yê·ra‘ lə·ḇā·ḇə·ḵā bə·ṯit·tə·ḵā lōw kî biḡ·lal had·dā·ḇār haz·zeh yə·ḇā·reḵ·ḵā Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā bə·ḵāl ma·‘ă·śe·ḵā ū·ḇə·ḵōl miš·laḥ yā·ḏe·ḵā
verses.literal: Give generously . . . to him and do not let your heart be grieved when you do so . . . . . . And because of . . . this the LORD your God will bless you in all your work and in everything to which you put your hand
verses.literalPt: Sem falta lho darás, e não será triste o teu coração quando lho deres; pois por isso te abençoará Jeová, teu Deus, em todas as tuas obras e em todas as coisas em que puseres a mão.

verses.original: כִּ֛י לֹא־ יֶחְדַּ֥ל אֶבְי֖וֹן מִקֶּ֣רֶב הָאָ֑רֶץ עַל־ כֵּ֞ן אָנֹכִ֤י מְצַוְּךָ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר פָּ֠תֹחַ תִּפְתַּ֨ח אֶת־ יָדְךָ֜ לְאָחִ֧יךָ לַעֲנִיֶּ֛ךָ וּלְאֶבְיֹנְךָ֖ בְּאַרְצֶֽךָ׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî lō- yeḥ·dal ’eḇ·yō·wn miq·qe·reḇ hā·’ā·reṣ ‘al- kên ’ā·nō·ḵî mə·ṣaw·wə·ḵā lê·mōr pā·ṯō·aḥ tip̄·taḥ ’eṯ- yā·ḏə·ḵā lə·’ā·ḥî·ḵā la·‘ă·nî·ye·ḵā ū·lə·’eḇ·yō·nə·ḵā bə·’ar·ṣe·ḵā
verses.literal: For there will never cease to be poor in the land that is why . . . I am commanding you to open wide your hand to your brother and to the poor and needy in your land
verses.literalPt: Pois nunca deixará de haver pobres na terra; portanto, eu te ordeno, dizendo: Sem falta abrirás a mão para o teu irmão, para o teu necessitado e para o teu pobre, na tua terra.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ יִמָּכֵ֨ר לְךָ֜ אָחִ֣יךָ הָֽעִבְרִ֗י א֚וֹ הָֽעִבְרִיָּ֔ה וַעֲבָֽדְךָ֖ שֵׁ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֑ים וּבַשָּׁנָה֙ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔ת תְּשַׁלְּחֶ֥נּוּ חָפְשִׁ֖י מֵעִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- yim·mā·ḵêr lə·ḵā ’ā·ḥî·ḵā hā·‘iḇ·rî ’ōw hā·‘iḇ·rî·yāh wa·‘ă·ḇā·ḏə·ḵā šêš šā·nîm ū·ḇaš·šā·nāh haš·šə·ḇî·‘iṯ tə·šal·lə·ḥen·nū ḥā·p̄ə·šî mê·‘im·māḵ
verses.literal: If a fellow Hebrew a man or a woman is sold to you and serves you six years then in the seventh year you must set him free . . .
verses.literalPt: Se te for vendido um teu irmão hebreu (ou hebreia), servir-te-á seis anos, e, no sétimo ano, o deixarás ir livre.

verses.original: וְכִֽי־ תְשַׁלְּחֶ֥נּוּ חָפְשִׁ֖י מֵֽעִמָּ֑ךְ לֹ֥א תְשַׁלְּחֶ֖נּוּ רֵיקָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵî- ṯə·šal·lə·ḥen·nū ḥā·p̄ə·šî mê·‘im·māḵ lō ṯə·šal·lə·ḥen·nū rê·qām
verses.literal: And when you release him . . . . . . do not send him away empty-handed
verses.literalPt: Quando o deixares ir livre, não o deixarás ir vazio;

verses.original: הַעֲנֵ֤יק תַּעֲנִיק֙ ל֔וֹ מִצֹּ֣אנְךָ֔ וּמִֽגָּרְנְךָ֖ וּמִיִּקְבֶ֑ךָ אֲשֶׁ֧ר בֵּרַכְךָ֛ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ תִּתֶּן־ לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ha·‘ă·nêq ta·‘ă·nîq lōw miṣ·ṣō·nə·ḵā ū·mig·gā·rə·nə·ḵā ū·mî·yiq·ḇe·ḵā ’ă·šer bê·raḵ·ḵā Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā tit·ten- lōw
verses.literal: You are to furnish him liberally . . . from your flock your threshing floor and your winepress You shall give to him as the LORD your God has blessed you
verses.literalPt: liberalmente o fornecerás do teu rebanho, da tua eira e do teu lagar; dar-lhe-ás, como Jeová, teu Deus, te houver abençoado.

verses.original: וְזָכַרְתָּ֗ כִּ֣י עֶ֤בֶד הָיִ֙יתָ֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם וַֽיִּפְדְּךָ֖ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ עַל־ כֵּ֞ן אָנֹכִ֧י מְצַוְּךָ֛ אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּ֖ה הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·zā·ḵar·tā kî ‘e·ḇeḏ hā·yî·ṯā bə·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim way·yip̄·də·ḵā Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ‘al- kên ’ā·nō·ḵî mə·ṣaw·wə·ḵā ’eṯ- had·dā·ḇār haz·zeh hay·yō·wm
verses.literal: Remember that you were slaves in the land of Egypt and the LORD your God redeemed you that is why . . . I am giving you this command today
verses.literalPt: Lembrar-te-ás de que foste escravo na terra do Egito e de que Jeová, teu Deus, te remiu; portanto, eu hoje te ordeno isso.

verses.original: וְהָיָה֙ כִּֽי־ יֹאמַ֣ר אֵלֶ֔יךָ לֹ֥א אֵצֵ֖א מֵעִמָּ֑ךְ כִּ֤י אֲהֵֽבְךָ֙ וְאֶת־ בֵּיתֶ֔ךָ כִּי־ ט֥וֹב ל֖וֹ עִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh kî- yō·mar ’ê·le·ḵā lō ’ê·ṣê mê·‘im·māḵ kî ’ă·hê·ḇə·ḵā wə·’eṯ- bê·ṯe·ḵā kî- ṭō·wḇ lōw ‘im·māḵ
verses.literal: But if your servant says to you I do not want to leave you because he loves you and your household and is well off with you
verses.literalPt: Se ele te disser: Não sairei de ti, porquanto te amo a ti e a tua casa, por estar bem contigo,

verses.original: וְלָקַחְתָּ֣ אֶת־ הַמַּרְצֵ֗עַ וְנָתַתָּ֤ה בְאָזְנוֹ֙ וּבַדֶּ֔לֶת וְהָיָ֥ה לְךָ֖ עֶ֣בֶד עוֹלָ֑ם וְאַ֥ף לַאֲמָתְךָ֖ תַּעֲשֶׂה־ כֵּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lā·qaḥ·tā ’eṯ- ham·mar·ṣê·a‘ wə·nā·ṯat·tāh ḇə·’ā·zə·nōw ū·ḇad·de·leṯ wə·hā·yāh lə·ḵā ‘e·ḇeḏ ‘ō·w·lām wə·’ap̄ la·’ă·mā·ṯə·ḵā ta·‘ă·śeh- kên
verses.literal: then take an awl and pierce it through his ear into the door and he will become your servant for life And treat your maidservant the same way
verses.literalPt: tomarás uma sovela e furar-lhe-ás a orelha à porta, e ele ficará teu escravo para sempre. O mesmo farás à tua escrava.

verses.original: לֹא־ יִקְשֶׁ֣ה בְעֵינֶ֗ךָ בְּשַׁלֵּֽחֲךָ֙ אֹת֤וֹ חָפְשִׁי֙ מֵֽעִמָּ֔ךְ כִּ֗י מִשְׁנֶה֙ שְׂכַ֣ר שָׂכִ֔יר עֲבָֽדְךָ֖ שֵׁ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֑ים וּבֵֽרַכְךָ֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ בְּכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּעֲשֶֽׂה׃פ
verses.transliteration: lō- yiq·šeh ḇə·‘ê·ne·ḵā bə·šal·lê·ḥă·ḵā ’ō·ṯōw ḥā·p̄ə·šî mê·‘im·māḵ kî miš·neh śə·ḵar śā·ḵîr ‘ă·ḇā·ḏə·ḵā šêš šā·nîm ū·ḇê·raḵ·ḵā Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā bə·ḵōl ’ă·šer ta·‘ă·śeh
verses.literal: Do not regard it as a hardship . . . to set your servant free because his six years of service were worth twice the wages of a hired hand And the LORD your God will bless you in all you do
verses.literalPt: Não te parecerá uma dureza quando o deixares ir livre, pois te serviu seis anos, o que vem a ser o dobro do salário dum mercenário; e Jeová, teu Deus, te abençoará em tudo quanto fizeres.

verses.original: כָּֽל־ הַבְּכ֡וֹר אֲשֶׁר֩ יִוָּלֵ֨ד בִּבְקָרְךָ֤ וּבְצֹֽאנְךָ֙ הַזָּכָ֔ר תַּקְדִּ֖ישׁ לַיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ לֹ֤א תַעֲבֹד֙ בִּבְכֹ֣ר שׁוֹרֶ֔ךָ וְלֹ֥א תָגֹ֖ז בְּכ֥וֹר צֹאנֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- hab·bə·ḵō·wr ’ă·šer yiw·wā·lêḏ biḇ·qā·rə·ḵā ū·ḇə·ṣō·nə·ḵā haz·zā·ḵār taq·dîš Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā lō ṯa·‘ă·ḇōḏ biḇ·ḵōr šō·w·re·ḵā wə·lō ṯā·ḡōz bə·ḵō·wr ṣō·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: You must set apart to the LORD your God every firstborn male produced by your herds and flocks You are not to put the firstborn of your oxen to work nor are you to shear the firstborn of your flock
verses.literalPt: Consagrarás a Jeová, teu Deus, todos os primogênitos que nascerem do teu gado ou do teu rebanho; não trabalharás com o primogênito do teu boi, nem tosquiarás o primogênito do teu rebanho.

verses.original: לִפְנֵי֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֤יךָ תֹאכֲלֶ֙נּוּ֙ שָׁנָ֣ה בְשָׁנָ֔ה בַּמָּק֖וֹם אֲשֶׁר־ יִבְחַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה אַתָּ֖ה וּבֵיתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: lip̄·nê Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ṯō·ḵă·len·nū šā·nāh ḇə·šā·nāh bam·mā·qō·wm ’ă·šer- yiḇ·ḥar Yah·weh ’at·tāh ū·ḇê·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: Each year . . . you and your household are to eat it before the LORD your God in the place the LORD will choose
verses.literalPt: Comê-lo-ás, tu e a tua casa, diante de Jeová, teu Deus, ano após ano, no lugar que Jeová escolher.

verses.original: וְכִֽי־ יִהְיֶ֨ה ב֜וֹ מ֗וּם פִּסֵּ֙חַ֙ א֣וֹ עִוֵּ֔ר כֹּ֖ל מ֣וּם רָ֑ע לֹ֣א תִזְבָּחֶ֔נּוּ לַיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵî- yih·yeh ḇōw mūm pis·sê·aḥ ’ōw ‘iw·wêr kōl mūm rā‘ lō ṯiz·bā·ḥen·nū Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā
verses.literal: But if an animal has a defect is lame or blind or has any serious flaw you must not sacrifice it to the LORD your God
verses.literalPt: Porém, se o primogênito tiver algum defeito, como se for coxo ou cego ou algum outro defeito ruim, seja qual for, não o consagrarás a Jeová, teu Deus.

verses.original: בִּשְׁעָרֶ֖יךָ תֹּאכֲלֶ֑נּוּ הַטָּמֵ֤א וְהַטָּהוֹר֙ יַחְדָּ֔ו כַּצְּבִ֖י וְכָאַיָּֽל׃
verses.transliteration: biš·‘ā·re·ḵā tō·ḵă·len·nū haṭ·ṭā·mê wə·haṭ·ṭā·hō·wr yaḥ·dāw kaṣ·ṣə·ḇî wə·ḵā·’ay·yāl
verses.literal: Eat it within your gates both the ceremonially unclean and clean may eat it as they would a gazelle or a deer
verses.literalPt: Comê-lo-ás das tuas portas para dentro; o imundo e o limpo igualmente comerão dele, como da gazela e como do veado.

verses.original: רַ֥ק אֶת־ דָּמ֖וֹ לֹ֣א תֹאכֵ֑ל עַל־ הָאָ֥רֶץ תִּשְׁפְּכֶ֖נּוּ כַּמָּֽיִם׃פ
verses.transliteration: raq ’eṯ- dā·mōw lō ṯō·ḵêl ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ tiš·pə·ḵen·nū kam·mā·yim
verses.literal: But you must not eat the blood pour it on the ground like water
verses.literalPt: Tão somente não comerás o seu sangue; derramá-lo-ás sobre a terra como água.
